newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar trades narrowly at close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar trades narrowly at close.

text.p: White sugar futures showed little movement during late afternoon trading after bouncing slightly from mid-session lows.

At the close near December was trading at $321.90, down $1.40 a tonne from Tuesday, after a day's range from $323.40 down to $321.00. Other positions were between $1.20 and $0.30 a tonne down and turnover totalled 4,190 lots.
The heavier activity today reflected increased interest in the near December/March spread, traders said.
But apart from this there was no news or movement in New York futures to encourage a significant market move here.
Paris white sugar last traded at $321.20 in near August to show a loss of $260 a tonne.
